morphology.pattern_note: 印度尼西亚语音节缩略词；wa、pem、red 是原短语的截取部分，不是马来语词缀。is_root 表示将缩略后的整词作为独立词汇单位处理；尚未核实其马来西亚标准词地位及规范读音。

senses.zh_definition: （印度尼西亚新闻业用语）副总编辑；wakil pemimpin redaksi 的缩略形式。
senses.en_definition: In Indonesian journalism, a deputy editor-in-chief; an acronym of wakil pemimpin redaksi.
senses.ms_definition: Akronim bahasa Indonesia bagi wakil pemimpin redaksi, iaitu pegawai editorial yang membantu ketua pengarang.
senses.nuances: 已核实的是印度尼西亚新闻业用法，不能据此标为马来西亚标准马来语官方词条；status 因此保留为 unverified。马来西亚语境通常可解释为 timbalan ketua pengarang，具体职称依机构而定。此处马来文释义为说明性转述，并非 DBP 原文。[ANTARA 新闻从业者的亲历记录](https://www.antaranews.com/berita/5060581/catatan-jurnalis-foto-susahnya-memotret-dengan-kamera-film)

collocations.zh: 副总编辑职位（印度尼西亚媒体语境）
印度尼西亚报社的副总编辑
collocations.en: the deputy editor-in-chief of an Indonesian newspaper

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报：介绍印度尼西亚媒体职称
dual_scenarios.ms: Wakil ketua pengarang akhbar Indonesia itu, yang jawatannya disebut wapemred, akan menghadiri mesyuarat editorial esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那家印度尼西亚报社的副总编辑明天将出席编辑会议；该职位在当地称为 wapemred。
dual_scenarios.en: The Indonesian newspaper's deputy editor-in-chief, whose position is known locally as wapemred, will attend tomorrow's editorial meeting.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp：同事讨论印度尼西亚媒体来宾
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Yang kat hujung meja tu wapemred akhbar Indonesia tu.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Orang yang berada di hujung meja itu ialah wapemred akhbar Indonesia tersebut.
dual_scenarios.zh: 桌子那头那位，就是那家印尼报社的副总编辑。
dual_scenarios.en: The person at the end of the table is that Indonesian newspaper's deputy editor-in-chief.
spoken_features: 口语名词判断句省略 ialah；职称属于印度尼西亚媒体语境。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Wapemred akhbar Indonesia tu dah sampai ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah wapemred akhbar Indonesia itu sudah tiba?
messages.zh: 那家印尼报社的副总编辑到了吗？
messages.en: Has the deputy editor-in-chief from that Indonesian newspaper arrived?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia tengah tunggu kat bilik mesyuarat.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, beliau sedang menunggu di bilik mesyuarat.
messages.en: Yes, they're waiting in the meeting room.

etymology.historical_story: Indonesian newsroom vocabulary often compresses institutional titles into pronounceable acronyms. Wapemred combines fragments of wakil, pemimpin, and redaksi, naming the person who assists the editorial chief. Its formation explains the otherwise unusual sequence of syllables. This is an occupational abbreviation documented in Indonesian journalism; it does not establish recognition as an official Malaysian Malay headword.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 wa—pem—red 记：wakil（副手）＋pemimpin（领导）＋redaksi（编辑部）＝副总编辑；这是缩略结构，不是已核实的规范发音。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 介绍印度尼西亚来宾时，首次出现应写出完整职称。直接称呼对方宜使用其姓名及适当尊称，例如 Bapak 或 Ibu。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于印度尼西亚媒体、采访及跨国新闻合作语境。面向马来西亚普通读者时，应补充职务解释，避免把该缩略词当作人人熟悉的本地职称。
